methodology.observation_window_basis: Window starts at the latest successful immutable run's window_end and ends at the current catch-up observation cutoff for the October 9 scheduled occurrence.
methodology.ranking_basis: Signal strength rather than popularity, emphasizing commercialization, deployment, manufacturing capacity, infrastructure, strategic partnerships, regulatory approval, and meaningful technical milestones.
methodology.source_policy: Prefer primary company, government, regulatory, and research-institution sources; use company investor relations or official newsroom releases when available.
methodology.repeat_policy: Recent immutable findings and event identities were checked; repeated events are included only for material updates with preserved event_key and material_update_from.
excluded_noise: market-price movement without underlying technical or commercial change

provenance.source: Scheduled weekday Technology Trend Update using live public-source research and the immutable GitHub ledger.
provenance.notes: Publication-request branch handoff; legacy history and longitudinal visual were not used.

findings.headline: GlobalFoundries sets 2028 manufacturing target for 7 nm-class FD-SOI platform built for physical AI
findings.summary: GlobalFoundries unveiled FDX Fusion, a next-generation FD-SOI process platform designed for physical-AI workloads spanning sensing, edge inference, control and connectivity. The first generation targets seven-nanometer-class digital performance, more than 2x density improvement versus first-generation FDX, demonstrator silicon in early 2027 and initial manufacturing at its Dresden facility in 2028.
findings.why_it_matters: This is a concrete semiconductor roadmap for power-efficient edge intelligence and robotics, backed by an identified European manufacturing site and customer development activity rather than a purely research-stage process concept.
findings.trend_statement: Physical AI is beginning to shape dedicated semiconductor process roadmaps that optimize compute, sensing, connectivity and power efficiency together.

source_links.title: GF unveils roadmap to deliver the world's most advanced FD-SOI platform for Physical AI

findings.headline: SpaceX moves Starlink Mobile toward full-carrier capability with nationwide 800 MHz spectrum agreement
findings.summary: SpaceX announced an agreement to acquire up to 14 MHz of paired nationwide 800 MHz low-band spectrum, pending FCC approval. The company says the spectrum closes a key technical gap for Starlink Mobile and will support a hybrid architecture combining satellite-to-mobile service with terrestrial deployment.
findings.why_it_matters: Owning low-band terrestrial-compatible spectrum materially changes Starlink Mobile's infrastructure position by improving range and in-building coverage while giving SpaceX a path beyond supplemental satellite connectivity toward a broader mobile-network architecture.
findings.trend_statement: Satellite direct-to-device networks are converging with terrestrial carrier infrastructure rather than remaining a separate coverage layer.

source_links.title: Building the world's most advanced mobile network

findings.headline: NASA and DOE formalize end-to-end collaboration on space nuclear power and propulsion
findings.summary: NASA and the U.S. Department of Energy signed a memorandum of understanding covering advanced research, fuel production, testing, launch integration and operations for space nuclear systems. NASA tied the framework to Space Reactor-1 Freedom, planned for 2028, and the lunar surface reactor program targeted for 2030.
findings.why_it_matters: The agreement establishes an integrated government development framework across the full nuclear-space supply chain, reducing organizational fragmentation around fuel, reactors, testing and mission integration.
findings.trend_statement: Deep-space infrastructure is shifting toward programmatic nuclear power and propulsion rather than relying only on solar and chemical systems.

source_links.title: NASA, Energy Department Advance New Era of Nuclear-Powered Exploration

findings.headline: FDA approves first adjuvant immunotherapy regimen for stage III dMMR colon cancer
findings.summary: Roche announced FDA approval of Tecentriq and Tecentriq Hybreza with fluoropyrimidine and oxaliplatin chemotherapy after surgery for stage III dMMR colon cancer. In the Phase III ATOMIC study, the regimen reduced the risk of disease recurrence or death by 50% versus chemotherapy alone, with 36-month disease-free survival of 86% versus 76%.
findings.why_it_matters: The approval establishes the first immunotherapy-based adjuvant regimen in this molecularly defined stage III colon-cancer population and introduces biomarker-specific treatment into a setting that had not previously differentiated standard adjuvant therapy by mismatch-repair status.
findings.trend_statement: Oncology commercialization is continuing to move treatment selection earlier in disease course and more tightly around tumor biology.

source_links.title: FDA approves Roche's Tecentriq in combination with a fluoropyrimidine and oxaliplatin for the adjuvant treatment of a certain type of stage III colon cancer

findings.headline: FDA approves once-monthly subcutaneous olanzapine without post-injection monitoring
findings.summary: Teva announced FDA approval of WELTRUZA, a once-monthly subcutaneous extended-release olanzapine for adults with schizophrenia. The product requires no loading dose, oral supplementation or post-injection monitoring and uses Medincell's SteadyTeq controlled-release technology.
findings.why_it_matters: The approval converts a widely used daily antipsychotic into a long-acting formulation with fewer administration burdens, addressing adherence and monitoring barriers that have limited long-acting olanzapine use.
findings.trend_statement: Long-acting drug-delivery platforms are expanding established medicines into lower-burden formulations with materially different care workflows.

source_links.title: Teva Announces U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Approval of WELTRUZA (Olanzapine) For Extended-Release Injectable Suspension

evidence.evidence_summary: GlobalFoundries introduced a seven-nanometer-class FD-SOI roadmap purpose-built for physical-AI workloads, with demonstrator silicon targeted for early 2027 and manufacturing planned for 2028.

category_assessments.justification: The window adds a dedicated semiconductor-process roadmap for edge and physical AI, but not a frontier-model or hyperscale-compute breakthrough.

evidence.evidence_summary: SpaceX agreed to acquire nationwide 800 MHz low-band spectrum to support Starlink Mobile's hybrid satellite-terrestrial network, pending FCC approval.
NASA and DOE signed an end-to-end collaboration framework for space nuclear power and propulsion spanning research through operations.

category_assessments.justification: Two independent infrastructure-level developments materially expand satellite communications and nuclear-powered exploration capabilities.

evidence.evidence_summary: FDX Fusion is explicitly designed for robotics, industrial automation, autonomous systems and sensor-fusion architectures, with early customer engagement and a defined manufacturing path.

category_assessments.justification: The signal is enabling silicon rather than a deployed robotic system, so velocity is positive but modest.

evidence.evidence_summary: GlobalFoundries tied its new FDX Fusion process to its Dresden expansion, customer evaluation milestones and planned 2028 manufacturing.

category_assessments.justification: A new process node roadmap with an identified production site, customer engagement and manufacturing timeline is a strong manufacturing signal.

evidence.evidence_summary: NASA and DOE formalized development of fission power and propulsion systems, including fuel, testing and operations, for future lunar and deep-space missions.

category_assessments.justification: The development is space-specific, but it establishes a concrete government program framework for advanced nuclear power deployment.
No transportation deployment or vehicle-system development inside the observation window cleared the materiality threshold.

evidence.evidence_summary: FDA approved Tecentriq plus chemotherapy as the first adjuvant immunotherapy regimen for stage III dMMR colon cancer after the ATOMIC study showed a 50% reduction in recurrence or death risk.
FDA approved WELTRUZA, a once-monthly subcutaneous olanzapine formulation requiring no loading dose, oral supplementation or post-injection monitoring.

category_assessments.justification: Two independent FDA approvals materially change treatment options in oncology and schizophrenia, including a first-in-setting immunotherapy regimen and a lower-burden long-acting formulation.

evidence.evidence_summary: GlobalFoundries defined a manufacturing path for a physical-AI process platform in Dresden.
SpaceX's planned acquisition of nationwide low-band spectrum adds a critical infrastructure layer for Starlink Mobile.
NASA and DOE created an integrated development framework for the fuel, testing, launch integration and operations required by space nuclear systems.

category_assessments.justification: The window adds foundational infrastructure across physical-AI silicon, satellite-mobile spectrum and space nuclear systems.
